description: Checks whether CSRD reporting applies to a company after the 2026 EU simplification, whether the voluntary VSME standard and the value-chain cap are relevant, and whether the Dutch CO2-Prestatieladder matters. Uses headcount and turnover; no account needed.

asked_by.description: Who is asking for sustainability information

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example NL

cursor.description: nextCursor from an earlier result of this tool.

employees.description: Average number of employees of the group

eu_parent.description: True when the group is headed in the EU (default true)

section.description: One part of a shortened result: a "$section" path from an earlier result of this tool, for example items/0/adoption. The other arguments stay as before, and cursor pages a long part.

turnover_eur.description: Annual net turnover of the group in euros

name: check_reporting_obligation
title: Check reporting obligations
